nodes.label: compose.example.ai.yml
nodes.rationale: Extends standard Docker setup with AI proxy (Pipelock), local LLM (Ollama), and external assistant (OpenClaw) for secure agent interactions.

nodes.label: Pipelock Security Proxy
nodes.rationale: Acts as forward/MCP reverse proxy for AI traffic; enforces DLP, prompt injection scanning, and rate limits.

nodes.label: Ollama Local LLM
nodes.rationale: Provides local LLM inference (e.g., llama3.1) for AI features without external API costs or latency.

nodes.label: OpenClaw External Assistant
nodes.rationale: Delegates chat to remote AI agent; integrates via MCP endpoint for financial data access.
